jurisdiction.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Bosnia and Herzegovina has no national AI strategy or AI law at state level. Its AI governance rests on the GDPR-aligned Law on Personal Data Protection of 2025, which regulates automated decisions and profiling and requires impact assessments, and on its 2026 ratification of the Council of Europe Framework Convention on Artificial Intelligence, approved by the Parliamentary Assembly and ratified by the Presidency in September 2026. It is a party to the Council of Europe's data protection convention (Convention 108).
lead_institutions: Parliamentary Assembly of Bosnia and Herzegovina
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 and 13 October 2026 at state level from the Official Gazette of Bosnia and Herzegovina and the data protection agency's website; a run cut off by a usage limit was resumed and its downloads re-read from the official texts. The communications regulator's and central bank's sites and Parliament's bill tracker were not checked directly. A reported parliamentary AI roadmap is tracked as a lead.

instruments.issuing_authority: Parliamentary Assembly of Bosnia and Herzegovina
instruments.current_status: Published in the Official Gazette of BiH no. 12/25 on 2025-02-28. Art. 120: in force on the eighth day after publication (2025-03-08) and applied after 210 days from entry into force, i.e. from 2025-10-04 (computed; the Agency's notice says application starts in October 2025). Art. 116 gives controllers two years from entry into force to align. Art. 119 repeals the 2006 Law on Personal Data Protection (Official Gazette of BiH 49/06, 76/11, 89/11) from the start of application.
instruments.summary: State-level data protection law adopted by the Parliamentary Assembly to align Bosnia and Herzegovina with the GDPR (Regulation (EU) 2016/679) and the Law Enforcement Directive. Art. 24 gives data subjects the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing, including profiling, with legal or similarly significant effects, and arts. 15-17 require information on the logic and consequences of automated decision-making; art. 37 requires a data protection impact assessment for systematic and extensive automated evaluation, including profiling, and for new technologies. Art. 67 bars competent (law-enforcement) authorities from decisions based solely on automated processing with adverse effects unless a special law provides safeguards.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Main binding framework governing automated decision-making, profiling and personal data used to train and run AI systems in BiH; supervised by the Personal Data Protection Agency.

instruments.summary: Decision of the Parliamentary Assembly, under art. IV.4(d) of the Constitution, consenting to ratification of the Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI and Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law, signed by Bosnia and Herzegovina in Strasbourg on 9 December 2025. It is the parliamentary step required before the Presidency ratifies the treaty.

instruments.current_status: Adopted by the Presidency at its 31st regular session on 2026-09-03 (no. 01-50-1-2342-27/26) with the Parliamentary Assembly's consent of 2026-06-30; published in the Official Gazette of BiH - International Treaties no. 9/26 on 2026-09-28 and, per art. 3, in force on the day of publication. The Convention's own entry into force for BiH depends on deposit of the instrument of ratification with the Council of Europe, not verified here.
instruments.summary: Decision of the Presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina, under art. V.3(d) of the Constitution, ratifying the Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI and Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law signed on 9 December 2025 in Strasbourg. Art. 2 incorporates the Convention's translated text (printed in the gazette issue), so BiH takes on the Convention's obligations for activities across the lifecycle of AI systems; art. 3 provides for publication in Bosnian, Croatian and Serbian and entry into force on publication.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Makes BiH a ratifying state of the first binding international AI treaty; the main source of AI-specific obligations at state level.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-13, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. State level only (entities out of scope §6). rak.ba, cbbh.ba not crawled; parlament.ba bill tracker not queried; CoE treaty office Cloudflare-blocked (AI Convention deposit date unknown). Resumed run: no earlier fragment; sources re-read 2026-10-13. Law 12/25 effective 2025-10-04 computed from art. 120 (in force 2025-03-08, applies 210 days later). AI Convention: Parliamentary consent (Int. Treaties 5/26, 2026-07-09) and Presidency ratification (Int. Treaties 9/26, 2026-09-28, in force same day) recorded separately (Armenia precedent). 2006 data protection law full text subscriber-only (lead). Convention 108: Presidency decision 01-1236-29/04 of 21 July 2004 (Int. Treaties 7/04, 2004-09-19). Units covered: Law: Official Gazette portal (sluzbenilist.ba) title search in Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian (Latin and Cyrillic): only the two CoE AI Convention acts carry AI in the title; Law on Personal Data Protection 12/25 read in full. No AI law, AI bill, deepfake offence or public-sector algorithm rule found at state level.; Government: Council of Ministers: no national AI strategy, AI policy or public-sector AI guideline found (2026 work programme has no AI item); Ministry of Communications and Transport: searched, nothing found.; Ministries: Education, health, justice, defence, finance, security, civil affairs: searched via web and gazette titles, nothing AI-specific found (Civil Service Agency only runs AI trainings/surveys).; Regulators: Personal Data Protection Agency (azlp.ba) archives scanned: no AI guidance or decisions; Central Bank, Communications Regulatory Agency (RAK), Competition Council: searched, nothing found.. Not reached: rak.ba and cbbh.ba not crawled directly (web search only); parlament.ba bill tracker not queried directly (web search only); Council of Europe treaty office (blocked by Cloudflare) for deposit date of the AI Convention ratification. Could not verify: Deposit date of the CoE AI Convention ratification instrument (Council of Europe treaty office blocked).; Parliamentary Assembly AI Roadmap (no official copy found).. strategy, government-governance, ethics, public-sector, procurement, cyber-security, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, generative-ai, drafts, historical: no material found.
